description: Use exact verifier-aligned pair slack as the repair objective instead of heuristic bad-count surrogates.
implementation_hypothesis: Changes the search score to the exact per-pair certificate margin.
easiest_falsifier: No verifier-aligned win over a surrogate baseline on 22, 24, and 50.
first_experiment: Deterministic hill-climb benchmark in the two-block family.
overlap_risk: High overlap with heuristic retuning if the benchmark does not improve frontier margins.
